onboarding.screennameDescription: Enter your name and choose a screenname. This is how you'll show up across Pana MIA — on your profile, on anything you post, and anywhere people find you. You can skip for now, but you'll need both before you can post or follow.
onboarding.welcomeBody: One last thing before you look around: enter your name and pick a screenname. It takes a few seconds, and it's what lets you post, follow, and be found.
onboarding.nameHint: Required. How you'd like to be introduced.
onboarding.requiredFields: Enter your name and choose a screenname to continue.
onboarding.screennameHint: Required. 3–24 characters. Letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.
onboarding.screennameCooldown: Choose carefully — you can change it again after 90 days.
onboarding.privacyNote: Your name and screenname are public. Your email stays private.
onboarding.skipCost: You can look around without completing setup, but you'll need a name and screenname before you can post or follow.
onboarding.checkFailed: Could not check that name. Try again.
onboarding.setFailed: Could not save that screenname. Try again.
onboarding.finishSetupHint: Pick a screenname to post and follow
onboarding.startTitle: Where do you want to start?
onboarding.startBody: You're @{{screenname}} now. All of this stays open to you — this is just the quickest way in.
onboarding.startDirectoryBody: Find the makers, shops, and artists around you.
onboarding.startSocialBody: Pana Social is the community timeline. Post, follow, reply.
